name: Threads
description: WebGL2 background of many thin flowing lines that wave like threads across the container, with optional mouse-driven motion and a pointer parting effect.
contents: Container div filling its parent with an absolutely positioned canvas
Instanced line rendering with Perlin noise waves, color gradient from color to accentColor, and an edge fade
behavior: Lines wave continuously, driven by noise over time
With enableMouseInteraction, pointer position eases the wave phase and amplitude
With parting above 0, lines push away from the pointer while it is over the container
Rendering pauses when offscreen, tab hidden, paused is true, or reduced motion is preferred
Render resolution is capped at 1920px on the longest side and device pixel ratio at 2
Transparent canvas so the page behind shows through
editableByProps: Line color and accent gradient color (RGB array 0-1 or any CSS color string)
Line count (1-400), thickness, softness, taper, brightness, opacity
Wave amplitude, wave frequency, speed, seed, line spacing, fray, split point, rotation angle
Mouse interaction, pointer parting strength, edge fade, pause
className and extra attributes on the container

needsCodeEdit.where: main function in the LINE_VERTEX shader string

needsCodeEdit.change: Raise or lower the render resolution cap
Listen to pointer on the container only instead of the whole window

fixed: Requires WebGL2; renders nothing if unavailable or shaders fail to compile
Fills its parent (h-full w-full), so the parent must have a size and the component is placed behind content by the page
Registers a window pointermove listener and tracks the pointer even outside the container
Respects prefers-reduced-motion by freezing the animation
Uses Tailwind classes relative, absolute, inset-0, h-full, w-full
Client component, uses browser APIs in an effect
Heavy GPU load with high lineCount on large screens; render scale is capped but mobile performance varies
